message: No detected input validation: The code reads config from YAML and passes data through pipelines without any schema checks, type assertions, or value-range guards on the incoming data or configuration values.

No detected untrusted source handling: No remote data fetching is visible in the code; all data appears to be loaded locally, and there are no checksum verifications, signed URLs, or pinned revisions anywhere in the shown code.
No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool before training.
No detected data poisoning defenses: No outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples is performed anywhere in the data preparation or training flow.

No detected model integrity verification: The code loads model weights via `model.load_state_dict(conf['best_weights'])` without any hash check, signature verification, or pinned revision check on the weights source.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks class balance, expected label sets, or anomalous sample distributions before or during training.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: The training loop contains no backdoor defenses such as trigger detection, activation analysis, or gradient anomaly detection.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (e.g., Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy) or DP-SGD mechanisms are used anywhere in the training code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial attack libraries (Foolbox, ART, CleverHans) or attack methods (FGSM, PGD) are imported or used anywhere in the evaluation pipeline.
No detected input sanitization: The inference path reads data directly from datasets and passes batches to the model with no shape, range, or schema validation checks on inputs.
No detected output bounds checks: Model outputs are passed directly through softmax and threshold comparisons with no NaN guards, probability sanity checks, or bounds validation before being used.
No detected prompt injection defenses: This is a vision classification model (ResNet/EfficientDet), not an LLM, so prompt-injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
